description: This Java class 'BaseResourceService' manages resources within the Thingsboard platform, including saving, deleting, importing, exporting, and referencing resources such as images, dashboards, and other resource types. It interacts with DAOs, handles resource data validation, and maintains resource usage updates.

classes.name: BaseResourceService
classes.description: Service class managing resource CRUD operations, import/export, reference tracking, and resource usage updates within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: saveResource
methods.description: Saves a resource, optionally validating and updating its etag.

methods.name: doSaveResource
methods.description: Performs the actual save operation, handling persistence and event publishing.

methods.name: saveResourceInfo
methods.description: Saves resource info data to the database.

methods.name: getUniqueKey
methods.description: Generates a unique resource key to avoid conflicts.

methods.name: findResourceByTenantIdAndKey
methods.description: Retrieves a resource by tenant ID, resource type, and resource key.

methods.name: findResourceById
methods.description: Finds a resource by tenant ID and resource ID.

methods.name: getResourceData
methods.description: Retrieves raw resource data bytes.

methods.name: getResourceDataInfo
methods.description: Retrieves resource data info.

methods.name: exportResource
methods.description: Exports resource info as a ResourceExportData object.

methods.name: exportResources
methods.description: Exports a collection of resources, handling images separately.

methods.name: importResources
methods.description: Imports resources from a list of ResourceExportData objects.

methods.name: toResource
methods.description: Converts exported resource data into a resource object, updating existing resources if needed.

methods.name: findResourceInfoById
methods.description: Finds resource info by ID with caching.

methods.name: findResourceInfoByTenantIdAndKey
methods.description: Finds resource info by tenant ID, resource type, and key.

methods.name: findResourceInfoByIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds resource info by ID.

methods.name: deleteResource
methods.description: Deletes a resource, optionally forcefully, checking references.

methods.name: deleteEntity
methods.description: Deletes a resource entity.

methods.name: findAllTenantResourcesByTenantId
methods.description: Finds all tenant resources with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: findTenantResourcesByTenantId
methods.description: Finds tenant resources with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: findTenantResourcesByResourceTypeAndObjectIds
methods.description: Finds resources by tenant, type, and object IDs.

methods.name: findAllTenantResources
methods.description: Finds all resources for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: findTenantResourcesByResourceTypeAndPageLink
methods.description: Finds resources by tenant, type, and page link.

methods.name: deleteResourcesByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all resources for a tenant.

methods.name: deleteByTenantId
methods.description: Alias for deleteResourcesByTenantId.

methods.name: findEntity
methods.description: Finds resource entity by ID.

methods.name: findEntityAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds resource entity by ID.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type managed by this service.

methods.name: sumDataSizeByTenantId
methods.description: Calculates total data size for tenant resources.

methods.name: updateResourcesUsage
methods.description: Updates resource usage based on dashboard or widget configuration.

methods.name: getUsedResources
methods.description: Retrieves resources used by dashboards or widgets.

methods.name: createOrUpdateSystemResource
methods.description: Creates or updates a system resource, handling dashboards and images.

methods.name: findSystemOrTenantResourcesByIds
methods.description: Finds resources by IDs for system or tenant scope.

methods.name: calculateEtag
methods.description: Calculates a SHA-256 hash as an ETag for resource data.

methods.name: findSystemOrTenantResourceByEtag
methods.description: Finds a resource by ETag for system or tenant scope.
